rationale: Operator chose b (2026-11-26, full rubric): each RFC declares reviewAuthorities in frontmatter and cli-merge-if-eligible refuses any PR changing a declared RFC, read from the base copy and failing closed; the operator merges by hand after the authorities reply. Counter-argument: a blanket hold on every RFC past Draft (a) fails closed where b is opt-in; b survives because a would mean about 30 hand merges a month of Engineering-only edits and train rubber-stamping, and a declaration is a one-line edit. Check: a GitHub draft PR on a docs/ branch routes to the planner rather than arming (the interim control until AISDLC-1449 lands; lander skips drafts, reconciler path unobserved). Undefined until AISDLC-1449 (#3094): the reviewAuthorities field, the refusal, base-copy read, declarations on RFC-0018 and RFC-0049. Provisional: Design Authority (Morgan) confirms it meets the RFC-0018 v0.4.1 sign-off condition; Product (Kline) replies.
